name: Brine crawler
height: 40 cm at the shoulder in its ordinary crouch
palette_note: The design does not assign exact hex values to brine-crawler shell, tail, weed or barnacles. Working swatches are prompt choices; kept front.png controls the production appearance.
locks: Low flat crab front with an 80 cm black-grey carapace; ordinary shoulder height 40 cm.
Exactly two serrated pincer claws on their own jointed arms.
Exactly six spiny walking legs: three on each side, separate from the two claw arms.
Exactly one continuous muscular eel tail from the rear shell root, 1 m long, with a low fin edge; no stinger or lobster segmentation.
Eyeless: no eyes, eyestalks or eye-like glowing marks.
One round ring of needle teeth under the front carapace lip, never on top or at the rear.
Violet Hush cracks in the carapace leak a few violet ash flakes.
Small attached clusters of barnacles and dark olive seaweed.
Dog-sized in ordinary movement; can rear up using the tail.
No scale silhouette on studio sheets; swarm retains an actual person for scale.
